instruction: Set up local folders called TEAM and MEETINGS in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the user to create two local Thunderbird folders named TEAM and MEETINGS. The evaluator uses the existing check_list function to verify that both folders are created correctly by checking for the .msf index file and the folder file itself in the Local Folders directory. The regex patterns check for TEAM.msf, TEAM (folder file), MEETINGS.msf, and MEETINGS (folder file).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts the required state: ls -R command on Thunderbird Local Folders directory captures all files and subdirectories needed to verify folder creation
Metric logic is appropriate: check_list function correctly applies regex pattern matching to verify presence of expected files in ls output
Expected regex patterns are semantically correct: patterns correctly represent Thunderbird's folder structure (TEAM.msf + TEAM folder file, MEETINGS.msf + MEETINGS folder file)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both required folders (TEAM and MEETINGS) with comprehensive patterns (4 patterns total, 2 per folder)

Regex patterns are well-designed: use word boundaries to avoid partial matches, negative lookahead to distinguish folder files from .msf files, and optional trailing slash to handle directory notation
Data flow is logical: postconfig executes ls command → saves to cache → getter retrieves cache file → metric performs regex matching
Practically feasible: ls -R command will work on the specified Thunderbird profile directory path, no timing issues as postconfig runs after task completion
